Black Friday is this Friday — and Americans are set to spend a record $275.1 billion online this holiday season.

That is Adobe's forecast for Nov. 1 to Dec. 31, up 6.7% from last year. Cyber Monday (Nov. 30) is still the single biggest online day at $15.1 billion; Black Friday itself is $12.9 billion and growing faster (+9.2%).

The part that follows you home: a forecast $21.3 billion of that spending goes on buy-now-pay-later, up 6.6%. That is a gift now and a bill in January.

My take: the discounts are real, but "pay later" is still pay. Splitting a $200 gift into four payments still costs $200 — plus whatever you miss if one is late.

Are you using buy-now-pay-later this holiday season? 👇
